channel.title: DEAD TAB — New Exhibits
channel.description: New exhibits in the museum of the forgotten internet.

item.title: Before the Feed: The Internet We Remember
item.description: How India experienced the internet before it lived in our pockets. Exhibit DT-001.

item.title: Cicada 3301: The Puzzle With No Author (Open Case DT-004)
item.description: Three signed puzzle rounds, an unfinished runic book, and a decade of silence. Facts and claims, kept separate.

item.title: GeoCities: The City That Vanished
item.description: The web's first folk city and the great rescue of 2009. Exhibit DT-003.

item.title: Orkut: India's First Social Network
item.description: Scraps, testimonials, and the shutdown of 30 September 2014. Exhibit DT-002.
